services: Roof repair, leak repair, full roof replacement, free inspections and estimates
facts:
- Rio Roofing, 2100 N 23rd St, McAllen, TX. We work across the Rio Grande Valley.
- Hours: Monday to Friday 7 AM to 5 PM, Saturday 8 AM to 12 noon. Closed Sunday.
- We repair and replace residential roofs: shingle, metal and flat roofs.
- Roof inspections and written estimates are free.
- Leak repair service call: $95, credited toward the repair if you go ahead with it.
- A new roof or a full replacement is priced only after an inspection.
- Every new roof comes with a 10-year workmanship warranty.
- Hablamos español.
greetingEn: Thanks for calling Rio Roofing. How can I help you?
greetingEs: Gracias por llamar a Rio Roofing. ¿En qué le puedo ayudar?
